title: King face-off
summary: Kings facing each other: the side not to move must give way.

steps.md: **Opposition**: kings face each other with one square between. The king who must move has to step aside!
Black must move and give way. White has the opposition.

steps.explain: Face-off! Now Black must step aside.
steps.hint: Put your king right opposite the black king.

steps.question: Kings face each other and it is Black to move. Who has the opposition?
steps.explain: The side that does NOT have to move has the opposition.

steps.prompt: Use the opposition to make a queen!
